placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Bristol Museum & Art Gallery lets a family visit follow the children's interests, from animals and fossils to paintings and objects from the past. Pick a few galleries and leave room to return another day.

Our family idea: each person chooses one object to show the others. Ask what they notice first and what they would like to find out, then swap roles in the next gallery.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Curious children and families with different interests.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Museum galleries and visitor facilities; consult the access guide for your needs.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Plan for city-centre public parking or arrive by bus; allow time to walk to Queens Road.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: General admission is free. Special exhibitions and events may need a separate ticket; check the current programme.
